title: Toaster: Nonlinear Memory from Cascaded Linear Memories and Target Propagation
abstract: arXiv:2611.23648v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recurrent memories let language models process long sequences with a fixed-size state. Linear memories such as DeltaNet and KDA store one matrix and take one delta-rule step per token. The product of a chunk of such steps has an exact WY form, so they train fast. Deep memories such as TTT-MLP and Titans store a small MLP, which can hold maps that no matrix can, but their update has no WY form. Toaster bridges the two by building on a known fact: a gradient step on a linear layer is a delta-rule write. It builds a two-layer nonlinear memory from two linear memories with an activation between them. We use target propagation to give the hidden memory its values by projecting the output error back through the second memory. Given a chunk's cross-layer signals, approximated once per chunk, each layer can then run on an unmodified delta-rule kernel. Our default runs this kernel on the output layer and updates the hidden layer once per chunk.

translated_title: Toaster：由级联线性记忆与目标传播构建的非线性记忆
translated_abstract: 循环记忆使语言模型能够以固定大小的状态处理长序列。DeltaNet和KDA等线性记忆存储一个矩阵，并对每个token执行一步delta规则更新；这类步骤在一个块内的乘积具有精确的WY形式，因此训练速度很快。TTT-MLP和Titans等深度记忆存储一个小型MLP，能够承载矩阵无法表达的映射，但其更新不具备WY形式。Toaster基于一个已知事实——线性层上的梯度步等价于一次delta规则写入——将两者连接起来。它由两个线性记忆并在其间插入激活函数，构建出一个两层非线性记忆。我们使用目标传播，通过第二个记忆将输出误差反向投影，从而为隐藏记忆赋予取值。在获得每个块近似计算一次的跨层信号后，每一层都可以在未经修改的delta规则核上运行。我们的默认配置在输出层上运行该核，并每个块更新一次隐藏层。
tldr: Toaster通过将两个线性记忆级联并插入激活函数、利用目标传播近似跨层信号，构建出可在未修改的delta规则核上高效训练的两层非线性记忆，兼具线性记忆的训练速度与深度记忆（MLP）的表达能力。
en_tdlr: Toaster builds a two-layer nonlinear memory by cascading two linear memories with an activation in between and using target propagation to approximate cross-layer signals, enabling efficient training on unmodified delta-rule kernels while combining the speed of linear memories with the expressiveness of deep memories.
